collection.title: Audi S4 Avant 2009 to 2015 Windscreen Wiper Blades
collection.description: All of the following wiper blades will fit a 2009 to 2015 version of the Audi S4 Avant which requires a 24" wiper blade on the drivers side and a 20" for the passengers side. This model uses the Slim Push Button Arm attachment to fix the blade to the wiper arm.
